title: ITR Filing Deadline for AY 2025-26: 5 Key Things to Know
description: The primary deadline for filing your Income Tax Return (ITR) for Assessment Year (AY) 2025-26 (Financial Year 2024-25) for most individual taxpayers has been .

faq.q: ### What is the last date to file ITR for AY 2025-26?
faq.a: For most individual taxpayers not requiring a tax audit, the extended deadline for filing Income Tax Returns for Assessment Year 2025-26 (Financial Year 2024-25) is September 16, 2025.

faq.q: ### What happens if I miss the ITR filing deadline?
faq.a: If you miss the deadline, you may have to pay a late filing fee of up to ₹5,000 (₹1,000 if income is ≤ ₹5 lakh) under Section 234F, plus interest at 1% per month on any unpaid tax under Section 234A. You also lose the ability to carry forward certain losses.

faq.q: ### Can I file my ITR after the deadline?
faq.a: Yes, you can file a "belated return" for AY 2025-26 until December 31, 2025, but it will attract late fees and other penalties. You can also file an "updated return" (ITR-U) until March 31, 2027, with higher penalties.

faq.q: ### Which ITR form should a salaried individual with capital gains use?
faq.a: A salaried individual with capital gains (other than minor LTCG from listed shares/Mfs up to ₹1.25 lakh) cannot use ITR-1. They should generally use ITR-2, provided they do not have business or professional income.

faq.q: ### Are NRIs eligible to file ITR-1?
faq.a: No, ITR-1 (Sahaj) is exclusively for Resident Individuals (other than Not Ordinarily Resident). Non-Resident Indians (NRIs) must use other applicable forms, typically ITR-2.

faq.q: ### What documents are essential for ITR filing?
faq.a: Key documents include PAN, Aadhaar, Form 16, salary slips, bank statements, investment proofs, Form 26AS, and AIS/TIS. These help verify income, deductions, and tax credits.

faq.q: ### Is it mandatory to e-verify my ITR?
faq.a: Yes, e-verification of your ITR is mandatory within 30 days of filing. Without verification, your return is considered invalid. The Aadhaar OTP method is the most common and convenient way to e-verify.

fact_check.summary: The article contains several inaccuracies regarding the ITR filing deadlines and some eligibility criteria for ITR forms for AY 2025-26 (FY 2024-25). The primary deadline for most individuals is July 31, 2026, not September 16, 2025, and the article incorrectly states that the CBDT has extended the deadline to September 16, 2025 for AY 2025-26.
